items.html: And therefore this Mochin precedes the rest, because no Mochin can come into being until Bina goes out, by the secret of the closed Mem, and nurses the son, so that his Mochin grows. Now when she went out, she entered the Rosh of ZA, who is the pleasant son; through what he nurses from his mother's milk, this Mochin is made. And just as the milk that is nursed makes the newborn's entire body grow, so this one governs the entire body, and waters all six extremities.
